name: Horizontal glide
description: One red string travels straight across the square from left to right. Rounded ends and diagonal shading follow the supplied artwork.
title: String tests — horizontal glide

name: Vertical rise
description: One blue string rises vertically through the frame, with its shaded bands traveling with it.
title: String tests — vertical rise

name: Diagonal pass
description: One yellow string travels diagonally from the lower left to the upper right.
title: String tests — diagonal pass

name: Traveling wave
description: A broad wave travels along a single green string that stretches beyond both sides of the frame.
title: String tests — traveling wave

name: Standing wave
description: A single purple string has still ends and a moving middle. Two opposing bends pass smoothly through a straight line.
title: String tests — standing wave

name: Downward ripple
description: A soft S-shaped ripple travels down a single pink string that extends beyond the top and bottom.
title: String tests — downward ripple

name: Around the frame
description: One blue string follows a rounded rectangular route around the inside of the frame, turning each corner without a cut.
title: String tests — around the frame

name: Open orbit
description: One open red arc circles the center. The gap stays open throughout the rotation; there are no crossings or knots.
title: String tests — open orbit

name: Elastic bend
description: One green string bends from a straight line into a deep open curve and relaxes back. Its centerline length stays constant.
title: String tests — elastic bend
